equivalences: Case/punctuation/diacritics, unambiguous translations or synonyms, word order and brand/range field partition may differ without changing identity.
Additional visible label wording may be retained only when it is consistent with the same beverage and all distinguishing reference content is preserved.
failures: Missing/wrong brand, type, flavor, range or distinguishing variant.
Conflicting fat percentage, diet/regular status or other material qualifier.
Unsupported additional identity or nutrition claims.
Missing/failed/invalid model output, uncertain identity, unresolved reference discrepancy or reviewer disagreement.
identity_requirement: Same complete beverage identity: brand, named range/product, beverage type, flavor and distinguishing variants present in the frozen reference. No category-only success.
legacy_metric: Retain unchanged preregistered exact name-alias metrics as a separately reported comparison; do not edit reference aliases or past results.
review_rule: Two distinct independently instructed Codex agent visual reviewers, blinded to run kind, checkpoint and scores. Identity passes only when both independently mark full_identity_equivalent; all uncertainty/disagreement fails. No post-score adjudication to increase success.
reviewer_kind: Codex agents, not a human study
target: Strictly above 70% joint full identity equivalence AND exact capacity on the held-out real-photo adapter run.
test_rule: Policy frozen before both baseline/adapter test inference; checkpoint/configuration selected using train/validation only; all 75 test cases remain in denominator. Preserve failed tests; later optimization requires fresh held-out cases.

user_authorization.quote: Count equivalent full identities; keep exact volume
user_authorization.source: owner conversation reply; not an external signature

volume_requirement: Exact positive integer printed capacity mL under the unchanged frozen reference and metric-first ROUND_HALF_UP rules. No tolerance, guessed capacity, remaining-liquid or consumption substitution.
